summary: Mission Control loses the mismatch count when valid and scope-mismatched candidate calls occur in the same Eve session.
inspection: Inspected story, Mission Control UI, reconciler result shape, workflow metadata propagation, server tests, and exact-head E2E. The mismatch-only path is covered, but mixed valid and invalid calls discard excluded-count evidence.
judgment_delta: Mismatch visibility is complete for all-invalid sessions but incomplete for mixed sessions, so the implementation needs one observability fix and regression coverage.

findings.detail: Return mismatched_candidate_calls on successful candidate write-back and cover mixed valid and invalid calls in unit and E2E tests.
